flags.name: api-archive-max-entries
flags.description: Set the maximum number of entries of a zip archive sent in the archives form field

flags.name: api-archive-max-ratio
flags.description: Set how many times its own size a zip archive sent in the archives form field may unpack to - guards against zip bombs

flags.name: api-bind-ip
flags.description: Set the IP address the API should bind to for incoming connections

flags.name: api-body-limit
flags.description: Set the body limit for multipart/form-data requests - it accepts values like 5MB, 1GB, etc

flags.name: api-correlation-id-header
flags.description: Set the header name to use for identifying requests

flags.name: api-disable-debug-route-telemetry
flags.description: Disable telemetry for the debug route

flags.name: api-disable-download-from
flags.description: Disable the download from feature

flags.name: api-disable-health-check-route-telemetry
flags.description: Disable telemetry for health check route

flags.name: api-disable-root-route-telemetry
flags.description: Disable telemetry for the root route

flags.name: api-disable-version-route-telemetry
flags.description: Disable telemetry for the version route

flags.name: api-download-from-allow-list
flags.description: Set the allowed URLs for the download from feature using regular expressions - supports multiple values. A match bypasses --api-download-from-deny-private-ips (API_DOWNLOAD_FROM_DENY_PRIVATE_IPS) and --api-download-from-deny-public-ips (API_DOWNLOAD_FROM_DENY_PUBLIC_IPS), so terminate the host or the pattern also matches suffix hosts, for example ^https?://internal\.svc(:|/|$)

flags.name: api-download-from-deny-list
flags.description: Set the denied URLs for the download from feature using regular expressions - supports multiple values

flags.name: api-download-from-deny-private-ips
flags.description: Reject downloadFrom URLs whose host resolves to a non-public IP address (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, unique-local). Enable on deployments that accept untrusted downloadFrom sources to mitigate SSRF against internal services

flags.name: api-download-from-deny-public-ips
flags.description: Reject downloadFrom URLs whose host resolves to a public IP address. Enable on air-gapped or data-governed deployments to prevent downloads from reaching the public internet

flags.name: api-download-from-enable-environment-proxy
flags.description: Route downloadFrom fetches through the proxy defined by the standard HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, and NO_PROXY variables, including credentials

flags.name: api-download-from-max-concurrency
flags.description: Set the maximum number of downloadFrom entries fetched concurrently per request - bounds the outbound fan-out. Set to 0 to disable this feature

flags.name: api-download-from-max-entries
flags.description: Set the maximum number of downloadFrom entries allowed per request. Set to 0 to disable this feature

flags.name: api-download-from-max-retry
flags.description: Set the maximum number of retries for the download from feature

flags.name: api-enable-basic-auth
flags.description: Enable basic authentication - will look for the GOTENBERG_API_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME and GOTENBERG_API_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD environment variables

flags.name: api-enable-debug-route
flags.description: Enable the debug route

flags.name: api-enable-oidc-auth
flags.description: Enable OIDC bearer token authentication - mutually exclusive with basic authentication

flags.name: api-oidc-audience
flags.description: Set the expected OIDC audience - the token 'aud' claim must contain it

flags.name: api-oidc-issuer
flags.description: Set the OIDC issuer URL, e.g. https://tenant.example.com/ - the token 'iss' claim must match

flags.name: api-oidc-jwks-url
flags.description: Set the OIDC JWKS URL - discovered from the issuer's well-known configuration when empty

flags.name: api-port
flags.description: Set the port on which the API should listen

flags.name: api-port-from-env
flags.description: Set the environment variable with the port on which the API should listen - override the default port

flags.name: api-root-path
flags.description: Set the root path of the API - for service discovery via URL paths

flags.name: api-start-timeout
flags.description: Set the time limit for the API to start

flags.name: api-timeout
flags.description: Set the time limit for requests

flags.name: api-tls-cert-file
flags.description: Path to the TLS/SSL certificate file - for HTTPS support

flags.name: api-tls-key-file
flags.description: Path to the TLS/SSL key file - for HTTPS support

flags.name: chromium-allow-file-access-from-files
flags.description: Allow file:// URIs to read other file:// URIs

flags.name: chromium-allow-insecure-localhost
flags.description: Ignore TLS/SSL errors on localhost

flags.name: chromium-allow-list
flags.description: Set the allowed URLs for Chromium using regular expressions - supports multiple values. A match bypasses --chromium-deny-private-ips (CHROMIUM_DENY_PRIVATE_IPS) and --chromium-deny-public-ips (CHROMIUM_DENY_PUBLIC_IPS), so terminate the host or the pattern also matches suffix hosts, for example ^https?://internal\.svc(:|/|$)

flags.name: chromium-auto-start
flags.description: Automatically launch Chromium upon initialization if set to true; otherwise, Chromium will start at the time of the first conversion

flags.name: chromium-clear-cache
flags.description: Clear Chromium cache between each conversion - only applies with --chromium-shared-browser-context

flags.name: chromium-clear-cookies
flags.description: Clear Chromium cookies between each conversion - only applies with --chromium-shared-browser-context

flags.name: chromium-clear-storage
flags.description: Clear Chromium local storage between each conversion - only applies with --chromium-shared-browser-context

flags.name: chromium-debug-protocol
flags.description: Log every DevTools Protocol message between Gotenberg and Chromium at the debug level of --log-level (LOG_LEVEL). The messages carry URLs, cookies and header values whole, credentials included: enable it only to troubleshoot

flags.name: chromium-deny-list
flags.description: Set the denied URLs for Chromium using regular expressions - supports multiple values

flags.name: chromium-deny-private-ips
flags.description: Reject URLs whose host resolves to a non-public IP address (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, unique-local). Enable on deployments that accept untrusted form input to mitigate SSRF against internal services

flags.name: chromium-deny-public-ips
flags.description: Reject URLs whose host resolves to a public IP address. Enable on air-gapped or data-governed deployments to prevent outbound traffic from leaving a private network

flags.name: chromium-disable-javascript
flags.description: Disable JavaScript

flags.name: chromium-disable-routes
flags.description: Disable the routes

flags.name: chromium-disable-web-security
flags.description: Don't enforce the same-origin policy

flags.name: chromium-enable-environment-proxy
flags.description: Route Chromium's outbound requests through the proxy defined by the standard HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, and NO_PROXY variables, including credentials. Use this instead of --chromium-proxy-server for authenticated proxies, and leave --chromium-proxy-server and --chromium-host-resolver-rules unset

flags.name: chromium-host-resolver-rules
flags.description: Set custom mappings to the host resolver, such as MAP intranet.local 10.0.0.5. The internal DNS-rebinding pinning proxy applies them and checks the address a rule maps a host to, so --chromium-deny-private-ips (CHROMIUM_DENY_PRIVATE_IPS) and --chromium-deny-public-ips (CHROMIUM_DENY_PUBLIC_IPS) still hold

flags.name: chromium-idle-shutdown-timeout
flags.description: Shutdown Chromium after being idle for the given duration. Set to 0 to disable this feature

flags.name: chromium-ignore-certificate-errors
flags.description: Ignore the certificate errors

flags.name: chromium-max-concurrency
flags.description: Maximum number of concurrent conversions. Chromium supports up to 6

flags.name: chromium-max-queue-size
flags.description: Maximum request queue size for Chromium. Set to 0 to disable this feature

flags.name: chromium-proxy-server
flags.description: Set the outbound proxy server; this switch only affects HTTP and HTTPS requests. Setting it turns off the internal DNS-rebinding pinning proxy: your proxy resolves each host after Gotenberg checks it, so a DNS rebinding can slip past --chromium-deny-private-ips (CHROMIUM_DENY_PRIVATE_IPS) and --chromium-deny-public-ips (CHROMIUM_DENY_PUBLIC_IPS)

flags.name: chromium-restart-after
flags.description: Number of conversions after which Chromium will automatically restart. Set to 0 to disable this feature

flags.name: chromium-shared-browser-context
flags.description: Run every conversion in one shared browser context, so cookies, cache, and storage carry over between conversions. Only enable it when all callers trust each other: a conversion can then reuse cookies another one set

flags.name: chromium-start-timeout
flags.description: Maximum duration to wait for Chromium to start or restart

flags.name: gotenberg-build-debug-data
flags.description: Set if build data is needed

flags.name: gotenberg-graceful-shutdown-duration
flags.description: Set the graceful shutdown duration

flags.name: gotenberg-hide-banner
flags.description: Hide the ASCII art banner above the startup summary

flags.name: libreoffice-allow-list
flags.description: Set the allowed URLs for the requests LibreOffice sends, using regular expressions - supports multiple values. LibreOffice requests only the style sheets an HTML document links, and the URLs a document's macros open once --libreoffice-enable-macros (LIBREOFFICE_ENABLE_MACROS) runs them; the images and other content an uploaded document links to never load. A match bypasses --libreoffice-deny-private-ips (LIBREOFFICE_DENY_PRIVATE_IPS) and --libreoffice-deny-public-ips (LIBREOFFICE_DENY_PUBLIC_IPS), so terminate the host or the pattern also matches suffix hosts, for example ^https?://internal\.svc(:|/|$)

flags.name: libreoffice-auto-start
flags.description: Automatically launch LibreOffice upon initialization if set to true; otherwise, LibreOffice will start at the time of the first conversion

flags.name: libreoffice-deny-list
flags.description: Set the denied URLs for the requests LibreOffice sends, using regular expressions - supports multiple values. LibreOffice requests only the style sheets an HTML document links, and the URLs a document's macros open once --libreoffice-enable-macros (LIBREOFFICE_ENABLE_MACROS) runs them; the images and other content an uploaded document links to never load

flags.name: libreoffice-deny-private-ips
flags.description: Reject the requests LibreOffice sends whose host resolves to a non-public IP address (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, unique-local). LibreOffice requests only the style sheets an HTML document links, and the URLs a document's macros open once --libreoffice-enable-macros (LIBREOFFICE_ENABLE_MACROS) runs them; the images and other content an uploaded document links to never load. Enable on deployments that accept untrusted documents to mitigate SSRF against internal services

flags.name: libreoffice-deny-public-ips
flags.description: Reject the requests LibreOffice sends whose host resolves to a public IP address. LibreOffice requests only the style sheets an HTML document links, and the URLs a document's macros open once --libreoffice-enable-macros (LIBREOFFICE_ENABLE_MACROS) runs them; the images and other content an uploaded document links to never load. Enable on air-gapped or data-governed deployments to prevent outbound traffic from leaving a private network

flags.name: libreoffice-disable-routes
flags.description: Disable the routes

flags.name: libreoffice-enable-environment-proxy
flags.description: Route LibreOffice outbound fetches through the proxy defined by the standard HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, and NO_PROXY variables, including credentials

flags.name: libreoffice-enable-macros
flags.description: Run the macros of the converted documents, including the ones bound to document events such as load. Macros run code inside the container: enable it only for trusted documents

flags.name: libreoffice-idle-shutdown-timeout
flags.description: Shutdown LibreOffice after being idle for the given duration. Set to 0 to disable this feature

flags.name: libreoffice-max-queue-size
flags.description: Maximum request queue size for LibreOffice. Set to 0 to disable this feature

flags.name: libreoffice-restart-after
flags.description: Number of conversions after which LibreOffice will automatically restart. Set to 0 to disable this feature

flags.name: libreoffice-start-timeout
flags.description: Maximum duration to wait for LibreOffice to start or restart

flags.name: log-fields-prefix
flags.description: Prepend a specified prefix to each log field key

flags.name: log-level
flags.description: Set the log level

flags.name: log-std-enable-gcp-fields
flags.description: Use GCP-compatible field names in log output

flags.name: log-std-format
flags.description: Set the format of the logs Gotenberg writes to standard error

flags.name: log-std-level-case
flags.description: Set the case of the level field in the logs Gotenberg writes to standard error, either lower or upper

flags.name: pdf-allow-list
flags.description: Set the allowed timestamp authority URLs for the sign and timestamp stages using regular expressions - supports multiple values. A match bypasses --pdf-deny-private-ips (PDF_DENY_PRIVATE_IPS) and --pdf-deny-public-ips (PDF_DENY_PUBLIC_IPS), so terminate the host or the pattern also matches suffix hosts, for example ^https?://tsa\.example\.com(:|/|$)

flags.name: pdf-deny-list
flags.description: Set the denied timestamp authority URLs for the sign and timestamp stages using regular expressions - supports multiple values

flags.name: pdf-deny-private-ips
flags.description: Reject timestamp authority URLs whose host resolves to a non-public IP address (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, unique-local). Enable on deployments that accept untrusted requests to mitigate SSRF against internal services

flags.name: pdf-deny-public-ips
flags.description: Reject timestamp authority URLs whose host resolves to a public IP address. Enable on air-gapped or data-governed deployments

flags.name: pdf-disable-routes
flags.description: Disable the routes

flags.name: pdf-enable-environment-proxy
flags.description: Route timestamp authority requests through the proxy defined by the standard HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, and NO_PROXY variables, including credentials

flags.name: pdf-max-concurrency
flags.description: Set the maximum number of PDF documents a request processes concurrently, across all requests - raising it trades memory and CPU for speed on multi-document requests

flags.name: pdf-max-embedded-file-bytes
flags.description: Set the maximum size of an embedded file read for validation - it accepts values like 50MB, 1GB, etc; empty keeps litho's default, 50 MiB

flags.name: pdf-max-image-pixels
flags.description: Set the maximum number of pixels an image may hold - 0 keeps litho's default, 100000000 (100 million)

flags.name: pdf-max-render-pixels
flags.description: Set the maximum number of pixels a page drawn as an image may hold, at 16 bytes of memory each - 0 keeps litho's default, 50000000 (50 million), a Letter or A4 page at 600 dpi. The render stage refuses a larger page; flatten-transparency composites at a lower resolution to fit

flags.name: pdf-max-stream-bytes
flags.description: Set the maximum size a PDF stream may decode to - it accepts values like 256MB, 1GB, etc; empty keeps litho's default, 256 MiB

flags.name: webhook-allow-list
flags.description: Set the allowed URLs for the webhook feature using regular expressions - supports multiple values. A match bypasses --webhook-deny-private-ips (WEBHOOK_DENY_PRIVATE_IPS) and --webhook-deny-public-ips (WEBHOOK_DENY_PUBLIC_IPS), so terminate the host or the pattern also matches suffix hosts, for example ^https?://internal\.svc(:|/|$)

flags.name: webhook-client-timeout
flags.description: Set the time limit for requests to the webhook

flags.name: webhook-deny-list
flags.description: Set the denied URLs for the webhook feature using regular expressions - supports multiple values

flags.name: webhook-deny-private-ips
flags.description: Reject webhook URLs whose host resolves to a non-public IP address (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, unique-local). Enable on deployments that accept untrusted webhook destinations to mitigate SSRF against internal services

flags.name: webhook-deny-public-ips
flags.description: Reject webhook URLs whose host resolves to a public IP address. Enable on air-gapped or data-governed deployments to prevent callbacks from leaving a private network

flags.name: webhook-disable
flags.description: Disable the webhook feature

flags.name: webhook-enable-environment-proxy
flags.description: Route webhook callbacks through the proxy defined by the standard HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, and NO_PROXY variables, including credentials

flags.name: webhook-enable-sync-mode
flags.description: Enable synchronous mode for the webhook feature

flags.name: webhook-max-retry
flags.description: Set the maximum number of retries for the webhook feature

flags.name: webhook-retry-max-wait
flags.description: Set the maximum duration to wait before trying to call the webhook again

flags.name: webhook-retry-min-wait
flags.description: Set the minimum duration to wait before trying to call the webhook again
